severity.label: ELEVATED
severity.description: Credible evidence of meaningful outbreak risk, limited transmission, or significant surveillance concerns.
severity.explanation: ELEVATED: Laboratory-confirmed case(s) detected elsewhere after travel from this area while official local reports show no recent cases: transmission may be going undetected. Two laboratory-confirmed cases travelled through this country in the last 42 days before diagnosis elsewhere: one on 2026-10-03 (diagnosed in Kenya) and one on 2026-10-05 (diagnosed in Nigeria). This shows a route by which cases leave the outbreak area; it is not evidence of local transmission.
